test_iterable_conversion: test that iterating over pandas Series or Index converts elements to underlying Python types like int, float, Timestamp
test_to_numpy_conversion: test converting pandas objects to NumPy arrays with various dtypes, zero-copy semantics, and na_value handling
test_array_property: test the .array property on pandas Index and Series returns the correct backing ExtensionArray type
test_numpy_asarray: test np.asarray on pandas Series with datetime, timezone-aware, and object dtypes produces correct NumPy arrays
test_to_numpy_multiindex: test to_numpy on Series with MultiIndex handles na_value and dtype conversion correctly
